{{Quote|Saw plenty of action with the 9th Engineering Battalion, mostly in the Western Reaches, but the massacre at Rampa I and what they did on Gall was just too much.|Lira Hardin, on her service with the unit|<ref name="Friends" />}}
The '''9th Engineering Battalion''' was a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]]. Later the 9th Engineering Battalion was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Lira Hardin/Legends|Lira Hardin]] was a member of the battalion before she left after she witnessed the [[Massacre at Rampa I/Legends|Massacre at Rampa I]].<ref name="Friends" />
